name: Apple Pie with Crisp Caramel-y Top

steps.title: Prepare the crust
steps.body: Prepare double crust pie dough. Put the bottom crust in a pie dish.

steps.title: Fill the pie
steps.body: Fill with **8 peeled and sliced baking apples**.

steps.title: Add the lattice top
steps.body: Place crust lattice top over the apples and seal and finish the edge.

steps.title: Make the caramel base
steps.body: Combine on medium heat: **½ cup butter** and **3 Tbsp flour**.

steps.title: Add the sugars and water
steps.body: Add **¼ cup water**, **½ cup sugar**, **½ cup brown sugar**, **¼ tsp cinnamon** and a pinch of salt. Stir until it boils, then simmer for 1 minute on low.

steps.title: Pour the caramel
steps.body: Pour over the lattice crust, keeping the mixture from flowing over the edge.

steps.title: Reduce the heat
steps.body: Reduce oven temp to 350°F and bake for 35–45 minutes more.
